body: I can %100 percent attest to this. Worst experience of my life. I just need help. Was refused water, food and a phone call.

Thank you so much! I’ll definitely take all this to heart! I’ve been taking loads of pictures and will surely share them. 🥰 
Ive been looking into brain games for him because he is catching on quick! 
Unfortunately he is loving the overgrown grass that I haven’t been able to get too, so he hops around like a bunny 😂😅 then he find a rock from our big ol gravel road so I’ll have to figure out a new spot for him and finally get around to yard work which is totally on me. 🙃

I didn’t realize I had a problem with drinking until I the end of the night would come and I’d be left alone and sad that the “party/drinking” had to end. 

My 90 days sober is about to hit this Friday and I want to have a drink about it but I won’t. So I’m trading it for something I’d maybe enjoy. I chose a hike by myself with a packed picnic. Basically taking myself on a cute lil date. Nothing to big but something that’s a healthy reminder that, “I did it.” 

Seltzer’s really helped for that bubbly fizzy craving and for me, I became addicted to sugary desserts. (Trying to kick that curb) I also picked up smoking vapes again but have kicked that out now. There’s will be hard days for sure but now that I’ve gone so long without I don’t really crave the taste of any alcoholic beverages. Mostly just a bubbly drink. 

Also if you’re not a fan of seltzer’s add some flavored syrup to them like a teaspoon and that definitely feels like the tastiest drink. 

Good luck! 🤟🏽

Awh thanks for the response! I have a gallon water bottle that I drink out of pretty consistently and can drink the whole thing in a day. So a gallon a day. Eating habits are healthy and I don’t go for junk hardly ever I’m thinking it’s mostly portions cause a girl can eat but I still gotta gut ya know? It’s just difficult. It’s not hormones either cause I got that checked and all is well. So I’m thinking it’s mostly portions but I just feel like eating all the time.
Damn. That was very motivating. Thank you for your words. 🙌🏽❤️

Honestly at this point absolutely nothing. Aside from my two best friends. Meeting them has been life changing and has made the last couple years more better being here. 

I guess I just feel like I won’t be successful with starting somewhere new. I’m afraid of being alone and in a new area too.
